pages.text: A nether Apocalyptium ice pop, hard enough to serve as a blade.$(br)Upon consumption, grants the eater:$(br)$(li)5 minutes of Rallied III$(li)30 seconds of Nourishment$(li)3 seconds of Resistance V$(br2)The first consumption permanently grants Apocalyptium Blessing: attacks ignore hurt invulnerability frames, potion effects, armor, enchantments, Resistance, and shields.
